parse.title: Perilous Moons
parse.wikitext:
==Rewards==
{{Quest rewards
|name = Perilous Moons
|image = [[File:Perilous Moons reward scroll.png|center]]
|qp = 2
|rewards = 
* {{SCP|Slayer|40,000|link=yes}} experience
* {{SCP|Runecraft|5,000|link=yes}} experience
* {{SCP|Hunter|5,000|link=yes}} experience
* {{SCP|Fishing|5,000|link=yes}} experience
* Access to [[Neypotzli]] and the [[Moons of Peril]]
* The ability to be assigned [[lesser nagua]] as a [[Slayer task]].

In addition, completing the quest counts as a normal defeat of the Moons of Peril, allowing the player to loot the [[Lunar Chest]] for further rewards.
The chest may be reached by starting from the central chamber, travelling into the south-western chamber, past a group of [[Sulphur Nagua]] to the south-western passage, OR through the safer north-eastern chamber, to the south-eastern passage.
}}
